# Frozen compiler profile execution requirements

These invented models test the custom `lifecycle/v1` language, not Foundry's
baseline workflow rules or a real task. They grant no authority or approval.
The semantic model remains the source of truth. This corpus adds no interpreter,
source format, consumer adapter, compiler feature or standard-conformance claim.

Two independent fixture authors prepare the following families before the harness
is implemented or any generated reducer is run against these cases:

- [integers](integers/requirements.md): exact uint64 eq/ne, optional review revision,
  zero, values above 2^53, MaxUint64, guard-before-overflow precedence.
- [presence](presence/requirements.md): optional strings, absent versus empty,
  equality and inequality presence, Unicode whitespace, list nonempty, all/any.
- [dispatch](dispatch/requirements.md): custom state/trigger pairs, self-loop,
  multiple terminals, declared effects, refusal precedence and owned copies.
- [textdigest](textdigest/requirements.md): reference bindings, exact text and
  independent TaskDigest vectors, including content and acceptance ordering.

Each family's model, requirements and external-package Go oracle is frozen by
`inventory.json`. The inventory records file sizes/SHA-256, canonical model
identity and the exact independent test/subtest names expected to run. It is not
an authenticity signature. The harness pins the inventory's own hash. Updating
an oracle after observing output is not a test repair: any correction needs a
written reason, new independent review, and a new freeze before a further run.

## Observable contract

The oracle calls only public generated `Transition` and `TaskDigest` APIs. Each
transition expectation compares every Result field and every returned Task field,
including nil versus non-nil empty slices, exact refusal order, stable source
transition identity, `example-only` mode and `none` authority. Digest identities
are literals, not values read from generated constants. Input and returned-data
mutation probes distinguish equal values from shared storage.

Input validation happens before pair selection; illegal pairs precede guards;
failed guards precede revision overflow; only then are declared effects applied
to an owned copy. An absent optional operand makes both eq and ne false. String
nonempty trims Unicode whitespace; list nonempty tests length, not string policy.
Model-specific guards alone define business restrictions. For example, a model
without outcome/owner/acceptance guards must not inherit baseline workflow policy.

All negative guard cases must use valid runtime inputs. Blank task IDs and invalid
review decisions are validation failures, not witnesses for a guard. A predicate
that is tautological over valid inputs need not have a fabricated false witness.
No exact effect-order claim is inferred from equivalent final Tasks: the harness
separately checks generated statement order against the declared ordered effects.

## Independent identity method

Authors encode the documented canonical field order and normalized model content
independently, using standard-library JSON and SHA-256 rather than Foundry's
canonical/model/codec/compiler functions. Family requirements record the concrete
method and hashes. Task revision is an exact decimal JSON string, nil acceptance
normalizes to an empty array for hashing only, owner null differs from empty text,
and text is not Unicode-normalized. JSON emits UTF-8 without HTML escaping, while
U+2028 and U+2029 use the documented escaped form. These independent calculations
are finite expected-value evidence, not an alternative production serializer.

## Verification gates

Positive runs must pass every frozen independent test and subtest, with no skips
or unexpected/missing cases; compiler-derived structural tests are additional.
Disposable generated-code mutation controls must first compile. A control counts
only when its intended named oracle assertion fails, not on setup, syntax, timeout
or unrelated error. Restoring exact original generated bytes must restore every
positive case. Equivalent mutations are not mandatory kills. The test harness
runs only reviewed repository fixtures, with local Go and no module downloads;
it is not an execution sandbox for untrusted caller-provided tests.

This bounded corpus does not exhaust all possible models, Unicode strings, input
values or generator defects. It complements existing strict decode/validation,
profile typing, baseline acceptance and consumer integration tests without changing
their source bytes or treating their shared implementation as its oracle.
